THE CANTONMENTS LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS RULES, 2002
THE CANTONMENTS LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS RULES, 2002
S.R.O. 745(I)/2002, dated 29.10.2002.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 41 of the Cantonment Local
Government Elections Ordinance No. LXXIX of 2002, the Federal Government is
pleased to make the following Election Rules, namely:---
CHAPTER-i
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be called the Cantonment Local Government Elections Rules, 2002.
(2) They shall come into force at
once and shall apply, notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any
other rules on the subject.
2. Definitions.---(1) In these rules
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context.--
(i) "appellate authority"
means an appellate authority authorized under these rules;
(ii) "ballot paper" means a ballot paper set out in Forms
IX(A), IX(B), IX(C) or IX(D) in the Rules;
(iii) "ballot paper account" means a ballot paper account
prepared under these rules;
(iv) "candidate" means a person nominated for election as
member;
(v) "contesting candidate" means a candidate who has been
validly nominated for election as a member or as a Nazim
or a Naib Nazim of a union
or as a Vice-President and has not withdrawn his nomination on or before the
withdrawal day;
1.[(vi) Delimitation Officer" means the Cantonment
Administrative Officer;]
(vii) "election" means election to a seat of a member held
under these rules;
(viii) "election agent" means an election agent appointed by a
candidate under rule 22;
(ix) "election petition" means a petition under these rules
calling an election in question;
(x) "Election
Tribunal" means an Election Tribunal appointed under these rules for the
trial of an election petition;

(xi) "electoral roll" means electoral rolls prepared under
rule 3;
(xii) "Form"
means a form appended to these rules;
(xiii) "material irregularity" means non compliance of the
provision of these rules which materially affects the result of an election;
(xiv) "minority
community" includes person belonging to the Christian, Hindu, Sikh,
Buddhist and Parsi communities, a person of the
Qadiani Group or the Lahor; Group (who called
themselves 'Ahmadis' or by any other name) or a Bahai or any other person who is a 'non-Muslim' as
described in the Article 260 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan 1973:
(xv) "nomination day" means a day appointed under these rules
for the nomination of candidates;
(xvi) "Ordinance"
means the Cantonment Local Government Elections Ordinance 2002;
(xvii) "petitioner" means a person who has filed election
petition under rule 51;
(xviii) 'polling agent" means a poling agent of a candidate
appointed under these rules;
(xix) "polling day" means a day on which the polling is taken
for election of a member;
(xx) "Polling
Officer" means a polling Officer appointed under these rules;
(xxi) "Polling
Station" means a premises where arrangements are
made for a poll;
(xxii) "President"
means the President of Cantonment Board and where a Board is not constituted,
the Officer Commanding the station;
(xxiii) "Presiding
Officer" means a Presiding Officer appointed under these rules and
includes an Assistant Presiding Officer exercising powers and performing the
functions of a Presiding Officer;
(xxiv) "publish" includes exhibition at a prominent place
accessible to the public;
(xxv) "returned
candidate' means a candidate who has been declared elected as a member of a 2[xxx] Council or a Nazim
or a Naib Nazim of a Union, or Vice-President of a Cantonment Board;
